name: sk-eli-mcp
description: Slovak legislation with verifiable citations, from the official Collection of Laws (Zbierka zakonov) on Slov-Lex: an act's metadata, its consolidated versions over time and the text of a chosen version, each with its national ELI identifier. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to Slov-Lex; nothing goes to MateMatic.
